component.name: LiveGuideTask
component.script:
sub init() m.port = createObject("roMessagePort") m.top.observeField("windowRequest", m.port) m.top.observeField("reloadRequestId", m.port) m.top.functionName = "serveGuide" end sub
sub serveGuide() if loadGuideData() then publishWindow(defaultWindowRequest())
while true message = wait(0, m.port) if type(message) = "roSGNodeEvent" field = message.getField() if field = "windowRequest" publishWindow(message.getData()) else if field = "reloadRequestId" if loadGuideData() then publishWindow(defaultWindowRequest()) end if end if end while end sub
function loadGuideData() as boolean m.top.errorMessage = "" if m.top.uri = "" m.top.errorMessage = "The Live TV guide URL is not configured." return false end if
response = fetchText(m.top.uri) if response.error <> "" m.top.errorMessage = response.error return false end if
channels = ParseJson(response.body) if type(channels) <> "roArray" m.top.errorMessage = "The Live TV guide API must return a JSON array." return false end if
m.channels = [] for each channel in channels if type(channel) = "roAssociativeArray" normalized = normalizeChannel(channel) if normalized <> invalid then m.channels.push(normalized) end if end for
if m.channels.count() = 0 m.top.errorMessage = "The Live TV guide returned no usable channels." return false end if return true end function
function fetchText(uri as string) as object transfer = createObject("roUrlTransfer") transfer.setCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") transfer.initClientCertificates() transfer.setUrl(uri) port = createObject("roMessagePort") transfer.setMessagePort(port)
if not transfer.asyncGetToString() return { body: "", error: "The Live TV guide request could not be started." } end if
timeoutSeconds = m.top.timeoutSeconds if timeoutSeconds <= 0 then timeoutSeconds = 10 event = wait(timeoutSeconds * 1000, port) if event = invalid transfer.asyncCancel() return { body: "", error: "The Live TV guide did not respond within " + timeoutSeconds.toStr() + " seconds." } end if if type(event) <> "roUrlEvent" transfer.asyncCancel() return { body: "", error: "The Live TV guide returned an unexpected network event." } end if
code = event.getResponseCode() body = event.getString() if code < 200 or code >= 300 return { body: "", error: "Live TV guide request failed with HTTP " + code.toStr() + "." } end if if body = "" then return { body: "", error: "The Live TV guide response was empty." } return { body: body, error: "" } end function
function normalizeChannel(channel as object) as dynamic title = jsonString(channel, "title") if title = "" or not channel.doesExist("entries") or type(channel.entries) <> "roArray" then return invalid if channel.entries.count() = 0 then return invalid
isLooping = channelLoops(channel) programs = [] for index = 0 to channel.entries.count() - 1 entry = channel.entries[index] if type(entry) = "roAssociativeArray" startTimeSeconds = mapServerScheduleTimeToRokuSeconds(jsonString(entry, "starttime")) if startTimeSeconds >= 0 title = jsonString(entry, "title") if title = "" then title = "Program " + (index + 1).toStr() programs.push({ programIndex: jsonInteger(entry, "index", index), title: title, description: jsonString(entry, "description"), url: jsonString(entry, "program"), thumbnail: resolveUrl(jsonString(entry, "thumbnail")), startTimeSeconds: startTimeSeconds, remainingSeconds: jsonInteger(entry, "remainingSeconds", 0) }) end if end if end for if programs.count() = 0 then return invalid
assignProgramDurations(programs, isLooping) return { title: jsonString(channel, "title"), description: jsonString(channel, "description"), thumbnail: resolveUrl(jsonString(channel, "thumbnail")), liveUrl: liveUrl(jsonString(channel, "title")), isLooping: isLooping, programs: programs, cycleDuration: programCycleDuration(programs, isLooping) } end function
function channelLoops(channel as object) as boolean if not channel.doesExist("entries") or type(channel.entries) <> "roArray" then return false if channel.entries.count() = 0 then return false lastEntry = channel.entries[channel.entries.count() - 1] return jsonString(lastEntry, "nextProgram") <> "" end function
sub assignProgramDurations(programs as object, isLooping as boolean) nextGreater = {} stack = [] for index = programs.count() - 1 to 0 step -1 while stack.count() > 0 and programs[stack[stack.count() - 1]].startTimeSeconds <= programs[index].startTimeSeconds stack.pop() end while nextIndex = -1 if stack.count() > 0 then nextIndex = stack[stack.count() - 1] nextGreater[index.toStr()] = nextIndex stack.push(index) end for
now = createObject("roDateTime") now.mark() for index = 0 to programs.count() - 1 duration = 0 if nextGreater[index.toStr()] >= 0 duration = programs[nextGreater[index.toStr()]].startTimeSeconds - programs[index].startTimeSeconds else duration = programs[index].remainingSeconds if isLooping and duration > 0 elapsed = now.asSeconds() - programs[index].startTimeSeconds if elapsed > 0 then duration += elapsed end if end if if duration <= 0 then duration = 1800 programs[index].durationSeconds = duration end for end sub
function programCycleDuration(programs as object, isLooping as boolean) as integer if not isLooping then return 0 duration = 0 for each program in programs duration += program.durationSeconds end for return duration end function
function defaultWindowRequest() as object return { channelStart: 0, channelCount: 6, windowStartSeconds: currentWindowStartSeconds(), slotCount: 48, reset: true } end function
sub publishWindow(request as dynamic) if type(request) <> "roAssociativeArray" or m.channels = invalid then return
channelStart = jsonInteger(request, "channelStart", 0) channelCount = jsonInteger(request, "channelCount", 6) windowStartSeconds = jsonInteger(request, "windowStartSeconds", 0) slotCount = jsonInteger(request, "slotCount", 48) if channelStart < 0 then channelStart = 0 if channelCount < 1 then channelCount = 1 if channelCount > 8 then channelCount = 8 if windowStartSeconds <= 0 windowStartSeconds = currentWindowStartSeconds() end if if slotCount < 1 then slotCount = 1 if slotCount > 48 then slotCount = 48 windowEndSeconds = windowStartSeconds + (slotCount * 1800)
window = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") window.addFields({ windowChannelStart: channelStart, totalChannels: m.channels.count(), windowStartSeconds: windowStartSeconds, slotCount: slotCount, reset: request.reset = true }) channelEnd = channelStart + channelCount if channelEnd > m.channels.count() then channelEnd = m.channels.count() for channelIndex = channelStart to channelEnd - 1 appendWindowChannel(window, m.channels[channelIndex], windowStartSeconds, windowEndSeconds) end for m.top.guide = window end sub
function currentWindowStartSeconds() as integer dt = createObject("roDateTime") dt.mark() utcSeconds = dt.asSeconds() dt.toLocalTime() secondsIntoBlock = (dt.getMinutes() * 60 + dt.getSeconds()) mod 1800 return utcSeconds - secondsIntoBlock end function
sub appendWindowChannel(parent as object, channel as object, windowStartSeconds as integer, windowEndSeconds as integer) item = parent.createChild("ContentNode") item.addFields({ liveUrl: channel.liveUrl, playlistSize: channel.programs.count() }) item.title = channel.title item.description = channel.description item.HDPosterUrl = channel.thumbnail
if channel.isLooping and channel.cycleDuration > 0 appendLoopingWindowPrograms(item, channel, windowStartSeconds, windowEndSeconds) else for each program in channel.programs if program.startTimeSeconds + program.durationSeconds > windowStartSeconds and program.startTimeSeconds < windowEndSeconds appendWindowProgram(item, program, program.startTimeSeconds) end if end for end if end sub
sub appendLoopingWindowPrograms(parent as object, channel as object, windowStartSeconds as integer, windowEndSeconds as integer) firstStart = channel.programs[0].startTimeSeconds cycleStart = firstStart if windowStartSeconds > firstStart cycleStart += int((windowStartSeconds - firstStart) / channel.cycleDuration) * channel.cycleDuration while cycleStart + channel.cycleDuration <= windowStartSeconds cycleStart += channel.cycleDuration end while end if while cycleStart > windowStartSeconds cycleStart -= channel.cycleDuration end while
while cycleStart < windowEndSeconds occurrenceStart = cycleStart for each program in channel.programs if occurrenceStart + program.durationSeconds > windowStartSeconds and occurrenceStart < windowEndSeconds appendWindowProgram(parent, program, occurrenceStart) end if occurrenceStart += program.durationSeconds end for cycleStart += channel.cycleDuration end while end sub
sub appendWindowProgram(parent as object, source as object, occurrenceStart as integer) program = parent.createChild("ContentNode") program.addFields({ programIndex: source.programIndex, startTimeText: formatRokuScheduleTime(occurrenceStart), startTimeSeconds: occurrenceStart, durationSeconds: source.durationSeconds }) program.title = source.title program.description = source.description program.url = source.url program.HDPosterUrl = source.thumbnail end sub
function mapServerScheduleTimeToRokuSeconds(value as string) as integer localTime = parseLocalScheduleTime(value) if localTime = invalid then return -1
localWallTimeSeconds = calendarTimestampSeconds( localTime.year, localTime.month, localTime.day, localTime.hour, localTime.minute, localTime.second ) return localWallTimeToUtcSeconds(localWallTimeSeconds) end function
function parseLocalScheduleTime(value as string) as object value = value.trim() if value.len() < 16 then return invalid if value.mid(4, 1) <> "-" or value.mid(7, 1) <> "-" then return invalid separator = value.mid(10, 1) if separator <> "T" and separator <> " " then return invalid if value.mid(13, 1) <> ":" then return invalid if not isDigits(value.mid(0, 4)) or not isDigits(value.mid(5, 2)) or not isDigits(value.mid(8, 2)) then return invalid if not isDigits(value.mid(11, 2)) or not isDigits(value.mid(14, 2)) then return invalid
second = 0 if value.len() > 16 if value.len() < 19 or value.mid(16, 1) <> ":" or not isDigits(value.mid(17, 2)) then return invalid second = value.mid(17, 2).toInt() if value.len() > 19 if value.mid(19, 1) <> "." or not isDigits(value.mid(20)) then return invalid end if end if
year = value.mid(0, 4).toInt() month = value.mid(5, 2).toInt() day = value.mid(8, 2).toInt() hour = value.mid(11, 2).toInt() minute = value.mid(14, 2).toInt() if year < 1970 or month < 1 or month > 12 then return invalid if day < 1 or day > daysInMonth(year, month) then return invalid if hour > 23 or minute > 59 or second > 59 then return invalid return { year: year, month: month, day: day, hour: hour, minute: minute, second: second } end function
function localWallTimeToUtcSeconds(localWallTimeSeconds as integer) as integer matchedUtcSeconds = -1 ' Probe both sides of a possible DST transition, then choose the first ' UTC occurrence if the local wall time is ambiguous. for probeDay = -1 to 1 probeSeconds = localWallTimeSeconds + (probeDay * 86400) utcSeconds = localWallTimeSeconds + localUtcOffsetSecondsAt(probeSeconds) if localWallTimeSecondsAt(utcSeconds) = localWallTimeSeconds if matchedUtcSeconds < 0 or utcSeconds < matchedUtcSeconds matchedUtcSeconds = utcSeconds end if end if end for
' A local time skipped by a DST transition has no corresponding UTC instant. return matchedUtcSeconds end function
function localUtcOffsetSecondsAt(utcSeconds as integer) as integer return utcSeconds - localWallTimeSecondsAt(utcSeconds) end function
function localWallTimeSecondsAt(utcSeconds as integer) as integer dt = createObject("roDateTime") dt.fromSeconds(utcSeconds) dt.toLocalTime() return calendarTimestampSeconds( dt.getYear(), dt.getMonth(), dt.getDayOfMonth(), dt.getHours(), dt.getMinutes(), dt.getSeconds() ) end function
function calendarTimestampSeconds(year as integer, month as integer, day as integer, hour as integer, minute as integer, second as integer) as integer days = 0 for currentYear = 1970 to year - 1 days += 365 if isLeapYear(currentYear) then days++ end for for currentMonth = 1 to month - 1 days += daysInMonth(year, currentMonth) end for days += day - 1 return days * 86400 + hour * 3600 + minute * 60 + second end function
function daysInMonth(year as integer, month as integer) as integer monthDays = [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31] if month = 2 and isLeapYear(year) then return 29 return monthDays[month - 1] end function
function isLeapYear(year as integer) as boolean return (year mod 4 = 0 and year mod 100 <> 0) or year mod 400 = 0 end function
function isDigits(value as string) as boolean if value.len() = 0 then return false for index = 0 to value.len() - 1 if instr(1, "0123456789", value.mid(index, 1)) = 0 then return false end for return true end function
function formatRokuScheduleTime(seconds as integer) as string dt = createObject("roDateTime") dt.fromSeconds(seconds) dt.toLocalTime() hour = dt.getHours() minute = dt.getMinutes() suffix = "AM" if hour >= 12 then suffix = "PM" displayHour = hour mod 12 if displayHour = 0 then displayHour = 12 minuteText = minute.toStr() if minute < 10 then minuteText = "0" + minuteText return displayHour.toStr() + ":" + minuteText + " " + suffix end function
function liveUrl(channelTitle as string) as string parts = m.top.uri.split("/") if parts.count() < 3 then return "" transfer = createObject("roUrlTransfer") return parts[0] + "//" + parts[2] + "/" + transfer.escape(channelTitle) + "/live" end function
function resolveUrl(value as string) as string if value = "" then return "" lowerValue = LCase(value) if lowerValue.left(7) = "http://" or lowerValue.left(8) = "https://" then return value parts = m.top.uri.split("/") if parts.count() < 3 then return value if value.left(1) = "/" then return parts[0] + "//" + parts[2] + value return parts[0] + "//" + parts[2] + "/" + value end function
function jsonString(value as dynamic, key as string) as string if type(value) <> "roAssociativeArray" or not value.doesExist(key) or value[key] = invalid then return "" valueType = type(value[key]) if valueType = "roString" or valueType = "String" then return value[key].trim() return "" end function
function jsonInteger(value as dynamic, key as string, fallback as integer) as integer if type(value) <> "roAssociativeArray" or not value.doesExist(key) or value[key] = invalid then return fallback valueType = type(value[key]) if valueType = "Integer" or valueType = "LongInteger" or valueType = "Float" or valueType = "Double" return int(value[key]) end if return fallback end function
